title: 2026-10-27 论文推荐
description: 10 篇推荐：SPECMEM: Accelerating Agentic Tool Calling via Live Memory Management (University of Illinois Chicago, 草稿记忆要活着：冻结库的接受率会漂移，在线写回换来 27% 接受 token 与 1.74 倍加速。)、GS-MoE: Training-Free MoE Compression via Groupwise Subspace Sharing and Pruning (Florida State University, 免训练双轴压缩：删掉 60% 专家参数仍保住 90% 推理性能，域外困惑度还低 20%。)、MPQ: A Message-Passing View of Post-Training Quantization (University of Maryland, PTQ 该做软后验：VAMP 保留跨块不确定性，Llama-3-8B 的 2-bit WikiText-2 困惑度降到 12.37。)
